Como última voluntad, creó la hermosa canción 'Dance You Outta My Head', expresando su deseo de llevar alegría a todos. Desde el hospital, escribió a sus seguidores pidiendo que guardaran esta canción especial. Ahora, queremos unirnos a esta causa. Compartimos el pegajoso sencillo disco-pop con el mundo y apoyamos la noble decisión de Cat de ceder todos los derechos de sus canciones, incluida esta, a su hijo de 7 años, Loren. Cada reproducción contribuirá a un fondo especial para garantizar el futuro educativo y económico del pequeño. When I tell you that these are the best protein cookies I’ve ever had, I mean that from the bottom of my heart! My husband asked me what was in them no less than 3 times and I still don’t think he believes that they’re completely flourless, eggless, dairy free and refined sugar free. But, they are in fact all of those things. AND they’ve got around 33g of protein per ginormous cookie so when I say they’re the holy grail of desserts, I ain’t lyin. Here’s how you make them 👇🏼 6 tbsp vanilla protein powder 3 tbsp oats 4 tbsp pb 2 tbsp maple syrup 2 tbsp almond milk 1 tbsp vanilla 1/4 tsp baking powder 1/4 tsp salt  ¼ cup chocolate chips 1-2 tbsp Valentine’s m&ms (for a more tummy friendly option, try @unreal.snacks or @lakanto for a vegan option) Pre-heat oven to 350F and line a small baking sheet with parchment. Add all ingredients except for chocolate chips and m&ms to a large mixing bowl. Mix together with a fork until a thick batter forms and all ingredients are fully incorporated. The batter will resemble traditional cookie dough, but may be a touch stickier depending on the type of protein powder you’re using. Fold in chocolate chips and m&ms. Using an ice cream scoop, scoop the dough into two large cookies. The cookies will spread a bit when baking, but I like to smoosh them down just a bit with my hand. Be sure to leave room in between so they don’t bake into each other. Bake for 10-12 minutes until cookie is set & golden brown. If the cookie isn’t quite set when you remove it from the oven, instead of baking longer than 12 minutes, place it in the fridge for 5 minutes, this will help it set. Enjoy immediately or store in an airtight container at room temp for up to 3 days. One of my favorite ways to organize my sewing room is to store my fabric like it’s in a fabric shop. And I can tell you there is nothing better than walking into this space and seeing all of my beautiful fabrics organized on the shelf!  Yesterday I decided to go through my fabrics and get rid of the ones I would no longer use. My style has changed, my use has changed and some of these fabrics I have had for 12 or more years. I decided that if I wouldn’t buy it in a store today, It was time to purge. I’ll donate what I no longer use to make space for new and updated fabrics!  I use foam board, I buy big sheets of it at hobby lobby, Micheal’s, Walmart, etc and cut it down to 7.5” x 10”. I fold my fabric in thirds, lengthwise. Wrap is all the way around the board, fold down the corner and secure the end with a pin into the foam.  Some people prefer other methods and I have found that this is what works best for me. Personally, I think comic boards are too flimsy and cardboard just isn’t as pretty but it’s cheap and will get the job done!! So do what works best for you!!  I like that foam board is all white and it’s sturdy. I have been doing this for over 10 years and it works great!  Mike had to fix my shelf for me, it was bowing a bit so he just used his pin nailer to secure the back in place. The shelf is from IKEA, but many years ago. I’m sure they have similar ones now that you can get.  So save this for later when you are ready to organize all of your fabric!!  #fabricorganization #fabricstorage #craftroomorganization #sewingroomsupplies #quiltingfun #quilt #sew #fabirc

Shrimp Spring Rolls 🍤 Recipe 👇🏽👇🏽👇🏽 In my recipe: Rice paper. Nori sheets. Avocado. Cucumbers. Sushi rice (I used jasmine). Shrimp. Salt, ground pepper, garlic powder to taste. Vegetable oil for frying. For the sauce: Soy sauce. Fragrant sesame oil. Sesame seeds. Instructions: First, prepare everything for assembly. Rinse the rice until the water is clear, then cook it with enough water to cover the rice by 2 fingers, bring to a boil, and simmer on low heat for 10-15 minutes. Cover with a lid and let it sit for another 10 minutes, then stir and cool. Fry the shrimp in vegetable oil for 2-3 minutes, season with salt and pepper. Slice the avocado into wedges and cut the cucumbers into matchsticks. From the nori sheet, cut a rectangle about 3 cm by 6 cm. Let’s start assembling: Dip the rice paper in water for 12-15 seconds, not longer, then moisten the working surface of the table or a board. Place the nori sheet on top, add 2 tbsp of rice, avocado, cucumbers, and line up the shrimp next to them, as shown in the video. First, wrap the vegetables, then the shrimp. Between those two saddles, which one do you think fits better? Is it a perfect fit? I included photos for comparison! Drumroll please... 🥁 The second one fits better! Between the two, the fiest one should not be rocking back and forth as much as it is. It means there's too much rock (curve) to the tree and it will not stay balanced on your horses back. Both saddles had a good bar angle (angle along the shoulder from the wither) from the left side. However, if you examine the photos) this horses right shoulder is bigger making that bar angle tight on the right side, which means both of those saddles are an improper fit. There is lots of factors to look at! Is it sitting flat on the horses back? Is it balanced? Is it tight/pinching anywhere? Is it sitting on the correct spot on the horses back? Is it lifting in the back? Is the gullet dumping on the front with a wide bar angle? If you're not sure if your horse is properly fitted and are experiencing pain/behavior issues, ask for help from a professional saddle fitter! Lemon Blueberry Crumb Cake 🍋🫐 Y’all this crumb cake is so moist and the lemon blueberry combo is so tasty and refreshing! This is one of my favorite breakfast crumbs. It’s easy to make and will not disappoint💛 I’m clearly ready for Spring time! Full recipe below.  Ingredients: Crumb:  * 3/4 cup brown sugar  * 1/2 cup cup all-purpose flour * 6 tbsp unsalted butter, melted Cake: * 2 cup all purpose flour  * 1 1/2 tsp baking powder  * 1/4 tsp salt  * 8 tbsp unsalted butter, softened * 1 cup granulated sugar  * 1 lemon, zested * 2 eggs, room temp * 1 1/2 tsp vanilla extract * 2/3 cup milk  * 2 cup blueberries  Lemon Icing:  * 1 cup powdered sugar  * 1/2 fresh lemon juiced  * 1 tbsp heavy cream  Directions:  * Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease 8x8 square baking dish or you can use a 9” round springform pan.  * Make crumb by combining all crumb ingredients together with a fork. Set aside.  * Combine flour, baking powder and salt in a small bowl and set aside.  * Beat butter and sugar till fluffy, about 2 minutes.  * Add lemon zest, eggs and milk and beat till combine.  * Add one cup at a time of flour mixture till combine. Batter will be thick. Fold in blueberries.  * Place half batter in baking dish and smooth out. Sprinkle layer of crumb in center and add remaining batter and sprinkle remaining of crumb on top.  * Bake for about 50-55 minutes if using a 8x8 baking dish. Would check as early as 45 minutes for a 9” round dish. Remove from oven and let cool.  * Make icing by mixing all ingredients together and drizzle on top of cake. STEAMED CABBAGE ROLLS: they’re basically low carb dumplings without the wrapper. It's perfect for my late night dumpling craving. Click link in bio for the full recipe and step-to-step instructions.  Ingredients: Cabbage 400g ground pork 2 inch ginger, minced 3 garlic, minced 1 carrot, diced 2 green onion, chopped 2 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp cooking wine 1 tbsp oyster sauce 1 tsp sesame oil 1/2 tsp salt 1/2 tsp white pepper Directions: 1. Using the knife, remove part of the tough stem at the bottom of each cabbage leaf. This will make it easier to roll later.  2. Blanch cabbage leaf in boiling water for about 1-2min, or until softened. Set them aside. 3. For the filling, combine ground pork, ginger, garlic, carrot, green onion, and the remaining sauce and seasoning together. Mix well.  4. Assemble: place a portion of the meat filling onto the cabbage leaf. Roll it up like a burrito. Repeat the same process with the remaining leaves and filling. 5. Steam cabbage rolls for about 15 minutes. 6. For the sauce, you can dip or drizzle with soy sauce or chili oil. I made my own sauce, which you can find on the blog! Air Fryer Crab Rangoon  • • Ingredients: •8 ounces cream cheese softened •3.75 ounces imitation crabmeat shredded (about 3 sticks) •2 thinly sliced green onions pinch white pepper •24 square wonton wrappers •1 large egg beaten •sweet chili sauce for serving Instructions: 1. In a mixing bowl combine cream cheese, imitation crab, green onion, and white pepper. 2. Mix together until fully combined and smooth. 3. Place 2 teaspoons of filling into the center of each wonton. 4. Brush perimeter of each wonton with beaten egg. 5. Push the corners of each side into the center of the wonton and seal the sides together. 6. Spray basket of air fryer with cooking spray and fill air fryer basket with filled wontons, making sure not to overcrowd the basket. Generously spray each wonton with cooking spray. 7. Set air fryer to 350°F and air fry for 6 minutes. Remove from air fryer and repeat with more wontons. Serve with sweet chili sauce. Historia y receta del bizcocho mojadito puertorriqueño, este es un postre muy popular en Puerto Rico, que se caracteriza por estar muy húmedo y tener un sabor dulce y aromático. Algunos de los ingredientes que se usan son la mantequilla, el azúcar, los huevos, la harina, el extracto de almendras y el sirope. El sirope se hace con agua, azúcar y algún saborizante como almendras, vainilla o brandy, y se vierte sobre el bizcocho caliente para que lo absorba y lo mantenga mojadito.  La historia de este ponqué se remonta a la época colonial, cuando los españoles trajeron a la isla el bizcocho de almendras, que era un pastel seco y duro que se conservaba por mucho tiempo. Los puertorriqueños adaptaron esta receta usando ingredientes locales y añadiendo el sirope para hacerlo más suave y jugoso. Con el tiempo, el bizcocho mojadito se convirtió en un símbolo de la cultura y la gastronomía puertorriqueña, y se suele servir en ocasiones especiales como bodas, cumpleaños y navidades. Ponque Mojadito receta INGREDIENTS 1 1/4 taza Mantequilla Temperatura ambiente (2 barras y media) 6 yemas 6 Claras 2 taza Azúcar 2 taza Harina (cernida) 1 cucharada Emulsión de su Preferencia Almíbar 1 1/2 Taza Agua 1/2 taza Azúcar 1 cucharada Extracto Preferencia o brandy INSTRUCCIONES  Todos los ingredientes fríos deben estar temperatura ambiente Prepara tu molde con mantequilla o spray para que no se pegue el bizcocho. Puedes usar papel de hornear. Cremar la mantequilla junto con el azúcar por 7 minutos. Añadir el sabor y batir por 5 segundos. Añadir las yemas una a una hasta que desaparezcan y con una espátula incorpora todos los ingredientes raspando los lados del envase. Añadir la harina en 3 partes, nuevamente con una espátula, raspa todos los lados En otro recipiente, batir las claras por 7 minutos Mientras las claras están batiendo, precalienta tu horno a 350 grados Fahrenheit. Unir las claras a la mezcla en 3 partes. Incorporando con movimientos envolventes. Vierte tu mezcla en el molde y acomoda con una espátula no lo golpees. Introduce tu molde en el horno ya precalentado por 45 minutos. Importante a los 40 minutos puedes verificar con un palito de diente si tu bizcocho ya este cocido. Almíbar Calienta en una hoya el agua y el azúcar. Cuando el azúcar este disuelta, vierte en un envase de cristal y añade el sabor. Deja reposar hasta que este tibio y vierte sobre el bizcocho caliente. #bizcochito #bizcocho #bizcochodominicano #bizcochopuertorriqueño #recetasfaciles #recetastiktok

Step by step passport renewal process. Be sure to save this reel for future reference.  Everything you need to know in one video.  - To renew your passport by mail go to the official U.S. Department of State website. There are a lot of other websites that will charge additional processing fees so be sure to double check you are on the official site. - To renew your passport, click on "Already have a passport" and then "Renew Passport by mail". You cannot renew your passport online at this time. - You will need to complete a DS-82 form. You can complete a fillable PDF and print it out, or print a blank form and fill it out using BLACK INK. There are certain criteria you need to meet to be eligible for passport renewal, so be sure you can check "yes" to all of the listed questions. - There will be a spot on the form to staple a new 2 x 2 passport photo. You can get a passport picture taken at most @walgreens. The process is easy and costs $17 for 2 pre-cut color passport pictures. - Staple your picture to the form and complete all of the required information. Do not forget to include your email address because this is how they will communicate with you. You must also sign and date the form or they will not process your application! - Finally, you will put the completed forms, your old passport book, and personal or cashiers check made out the U.S. Department of State with your name and date of birth at the top. The fee for passport renewal is currently $130. The application must be mailed through the US Postal Service (USPS). You cannot mail it through FedEx or UPS. Passport processing times are currently running 4-8 weeks, but there is an option to expedite, if needed, for an additional fee. Make sure to leave enough time to renew your passport - most countries require your passport to be valid 3-6 months after the entry date. READY FOR IT? ⤵️⁠ There is a lot of competition for attention online. ⁠ ⁠ So when it comes to marketing our books, we can’t be general. ⁠ ⁠ They need to know WHY they should pay attention and buy. ⁠ Humans are driven by feelings. ⁠ And one of the biggest ways that you can get your reader’s attention and make your marketing stand out is to tap into the EMOTIONS of your ideal readers. ⁠🤯 ✨So if you want your readers to remember your book, they must be engaged and impassioned by the interaction with your book and with you as the author. ⁠ 🔥Here’s how… ➡️ Add descriptive adjectives to your content. This shows readers the feelings they will experience through your book.  For example, if you’re writing a personal finance book that helps people save money you can use words like prosperous, empowered, confident, control, secure, etc.  Incorporate those words into your social media posts, website copy, ads, etc. to describe the feelings they will get when they read your book.  ❌ So instead of saying, “My book, Financial Freedom, will help you save money and grow your 401K.”  👍🏻Use something like, “Take control of your money and gain confidence in your financial choices with Financial Freedom.”  For fiction, adding a touchstone - like a movie, TV show, book, etc., that readers can identify with PLUS emotional adjectives will make a winning combo.  For example, if you write thriller novels use words like bloodcurdling, breathtaking, chilling, electrifying, etc.  ❌ So instead of saying, “Will Cory and Laura make it out alive? Find out in my new book Buried.”  👍🏻 Use something like, “Buried is a chilling dystopian thriller that’s Yellowstone meets Terminator set in the year 2197. This electrifying story will leave you breathless till the very end!”  ⁠ If this feels a bit much or impossible to do - I totally understand!  ⁠ ✨That’s why I created the Book Marketing Starter Kit - it removes the guesswork and walks you through this process (and more!) step-by-step. ✨⁠ ⁠ ✅ Visit my profile to grab your copy!  #authortok #authortokfyp #publishingmybook #bookpublishing #bookmarketingtips #authorsofbooktok #bookmarketing #bookmarketingideas #writingabook #authorproblems #authorslife

Preheat: Start by heating your oven to 350°F. 2. Cook Corn: In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add corn, salt, sugar, and pepper. Stir in flour. 3. Combine: Mix in cream, milk, thyme, and Parmesan until well blended. 4. Transfer: Put the mixture into a 9x9 casserole dish. 5. Answer me this: has any of your healthcare team members talked to you about cold intolerance 🥶? This topic isn't discussed NEARLY as much as heat intolerance (or at all) even though lotsss of people struggle from it. It's when your symptom(s) worsen when your core temperature drops by at least 1/2 of a degree 🌡️ The most common worsened symptom my clients notice from cold intolerance is tight muscles/spasticity and difficulty walking/balancing. This is most often caused from the temperature outside, but other reasons could include being sedentary, drinking cold beverages, etc. So... what do you do if you're experiencing worsened symptoms from your core temperature dropping? Here's a few ideas to warm up your core temp 👇🏼: 1️⃣ Bundle up - blankets (or my personal preference... flannel bathrobes - I can't resist the coziness), jackets, sweaters, you name it! 2️⃣ Sip hot beverages (water, tea, coffee, etc.) 3️⃣ Get moving! Choose some seated or standing exercises to do right then and there... even from your couch or bed. 4️⃣ Go for a walk, if you're able to (even around your living room). 5️⃣ Eat warm foods - heat something up in the microwave, oven, or stove. Have you ever noticed worsened symptoms when you're cold? ⬇️ Comment below! #drgretchen #multiplesclerosis #mswarrior #coldintolerance

This Marry Me Salmon recipe is a lighter version of the viral marry me chicken, except with flaky, buttery salmon. Ingredients: Salmon: 1 lb salmon, skinless, cut into 4 fillets 2 tsp olive oil 2 tsp Italian seasoning pinch of salt and pepper Sauce: 1 tbsp oil (use the oil from the sundried tomatoes, or can sub olive oil) 1 shallot, minced 2 cloves garlic, minced 1/4 cup sundried tomatoes, chopped 1 cup spinach, chopped 1/2 tsp dried oregano pinch crushed red pepper flakes pinch salt and pepper 1.5 cups 2% milk 1/2 cup low sodium chicken broth 1 tablespoon cornstarch 1/4 cup grated parmesan 1 tsp lemon zest  Instructions: Coat both sides of the salmon with olive oil and it's seasonings. Sear in a large skillet over medium-high heat, about 5-6 minutes, the flip and sear the other side. If your fillets are thick and still underdone in the center, cover for 2-4 more minutes. Once salmon is light pink, flaky, and has reached a temp of 145°, remove it from the pan and set aside. In the pan add additional oil, then quickly sauté garlic, shallot, and sundried tomatoes for 1-2 minutes. Add seasonings and spinach. Once spinach has wilted, add milk. In a small jar, shake together chicken broth and cornstarch (you can whisk them in a small bowl, too), then add to sauce. Also add parmesan and lemon and stir until sauce is bubbling and has thickened. Adjust seasoning as needed. Return the salmon fillets to the pan, cover with sauce, then serve and enjoy! #marrymesalmon #salmonrecipe #datenightin #valentinesday #cookingathome #mediterraneandiet #healthydinner

Okay EVERY variation known to humankind might be a stretch, but hopefully these 17 barbell squat variations hold you over for now! Each variation has its own purpose, therefore if you want to incorporate these into your routine make sure you understand why you are doing what you are doing. At the bottom of this caption is a list of each barbell squat variation and their purpose! The only other ones i can think of are the Hack Squat & Sissy Squat. Any others?  	1.	Regular Squat:  -Standard barbell squat  -Overall lower body strength -Quads, hamstrings, glutes -Balanced movement pattern 	2.	Full Depth Squat: -Deeper range of motion to help improving flexibility  -Stretches the hip flexors & low back -Targets glutes, quads, hamstrings  	3.	Sumo Squat:  -Emphasizes the inner thighs, glutes, and adductors more than the regular squat 	4.	Narrow Squat:  -More emphasis to the quads & less stress on the hips. -Increasing knee flexion & range of motion 	5.	Half Squat:  -Limits depth to engage the quads & glutes without engaging the knee & hip joints as much -Beneficial for injury modification (Comp to Box Squat) -Can emphasize tempo 	6.	Quarter Squat N Jump:  -Working power & explosiveness in the lower body,  -Helps with Vertical leaping ability. 	7.	Full Squat N Jump:  -Power & explosiveness,  but with the full range of motion it helps develop more strength & controlled power along with explosiveness. 	8.	Pulse Squat:  -Smaller, controlled movements at the bottom of the squat to target muscle endurance & time under tension. 	9.	Squat N Hold:  -Adds more time under tension as well. -Hold the bottom position to develop stability, strength, & endurance, more emphasis in core. -Improves Ease of Bathroom Activities 🚽 💩  	10.	Bulgarian Split Squat:  -Isolates the Quads heavy,  -Also targets glutes, and hamstrings -Helps improve balance & unilateral strength. 	11.	Pistol Squat:  -One-legged squat that emphasizes glutes heavily. -Also targets the quads -Helps improve power speed, balance & stability. 	12.	Front Foot Elevated Split Squat: -Increases the range of motion and improves flexibility as well as strength.  -Can target connective tissue more as well as muscle tissue.  -Targets quads and hamstrings. 	13.	Overhead Squat:  -Targets the entire body, particularly the core, shoulders, and lower body -Improves Stability, Balance, & Strength 	14.	Front Squat (Clean Grip):  -Targets the quads, core, and upper back while requiring shoulder & wrist mobility to hold the bar down. -Still targets glutes but not as heavy 	15.	Front Squat (Cross-Arm Grip):  -Reduces the shoulder mobility requirement & provides a more accessible option while still targeting the quads and core. 	16.	Zercher Squat:  -Helps improve Posture & Postural strength  -Greater emphasis on the quads, core, and upper back 17. Otra cosa a recordar es que el césped artificial necesita un drenaje adecuado para mantenerse en buenas condiciones. Si vive en un área con mucha lluvia, deberá asegurarse de que el césped tenga una forma de drenar adecuadamente. De lo contrario, el agua puede acumularse en la superficie y hacer que el césped se deteriore con el tiempo😥. Finalmente, deberá cuidar el césped una vez que esté instalado. El césped artificial es susceptible a las manchas, por lo que deberá estar atento a la limpieza de cualquier derrame o desorden. Crispy and Tender Chicken Nuggets 🍗  Sharing a quick and easy chicken nugget recipe that is relatively healthier and higher in protein compared to what you get when eating out! These use chicken breasts and are made right in the air fryer. I also make a sweet and tangy honey mustard sauce, but you can use any sauce you’d like! These are perfect for a weeknight dinner or meal prep that everyone will enjoy!  Ingredients: -1 lb chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes  -2 cups panko breadcrumbs  -2 large garlic cloves, minced  -2 tbs reduced fat light butter  -2 tbs Dijon mustard  -2 tbs regular (or a mix of hot and regular) honey  -2 tbs olive oil  -2 tsp onion powder  -2 tsp garlic powder  -2 tsp smoked paprika  -1 tsp salt  -1 tsp pepper  -spray oil  Instructions: -add the cubed chicken into a large bowl with olive oil, salt, pepper, onion and garlic powder, and smoked paprika; mix well  -thoroughly coat each piece of chicken in breadcrumbs and lightly shake off any excess  -place the chicken in the air fryer, spray with oil, and air fry at 400F for 12-15 minutes until internal temp is 165F; rest for 5 minutes  -heat a small saucepan on medium heat -melt 2 tbs of butter and lightly toast the garlic for 30 seconds  -add in dijon mustard and honey, whisking well until sauce is smooth  -allow the sauce to rest for 10 minutes  -gently toss the chicken with the sauce or serve the sauce on the side  #chicken #chickenrecipes #chickennuggets #recipe #easyrecipes #mealprep #dinner #dinnerideas #weeknightdinner #lunchideas #healthy #healthyfood #highprotein #protein #honeymustard #sauce #quickrecipes #simplerecipes #quickmeals #airfryer #food #foodie #homechef #cooking #recipeoftheday

Replying to @Blackshirtgirl  Chai syrup/tea concentrate is here! This is a kind of Starbucks copycat syrup recipe, my kids LOVE this one. One batch makes enough syrup for 13 8-ounce drinks. The printable recipe is also on our website if you want to print this off and see our notes on making this lower in sugar!  HOMEMADE CHAI SYRUP/TEA CONCENTRATE Ingredients * 2 cups hot water (just boiled) * 10 Tazo chai bags * 1 ¼ cups unbleached sugar (or regular white sugar) * ½ teaspoon cream of tartar * 1 teaspoon vanilla extract * ½ teaspoon ground cinnamon * ½ teaspoon ground ginger * ¼ teaspoon ground cloves * ⅛ teaspoon cardamom Instructions Chai syrup * Measure out 2 cups of water into a heat resistant bowl or large cup and steep 10 Tazo chai bags in the hot water for 15 minutes, occasionally stirring them to make sure they are steeping, but don't dunk them (this can result in bitterness).  * After 15 minutes, squeeze them out and discard. You should end up with around 1 ½ cups of very strong chai (chai concentrate).  * Add the freshly brewed chai concentrate to a small saucepan with 1 ¼ cups of sugar (we use Zulka unbleached sugar). Whisk in the cream of tartar.  * Heat over medium to medium-low heat until lightly boiling, reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes, whisking occasionally.  * Once the 10 minutes is up, remove from the heat and whisk in the vanilla and spices.  * Allow to cool completely. Store in a jar at room temperature.  * For drinks, use about 2 Tablespoons syrup for an 8 ounce drink. You can use 3 Tablespoons syrup for a stronger drink. Stir the syrup before using since the spices will settle at the bottom.   Oatmilk chai latte * For an 8 ounce chai, mix together 2 Tablespoons of syrup, 4 ounces (1/2 cup) water, and 4 ounces (1/2 cup) of oatmilk.  * Use hot water and hot oat milk for a hot drink, or cold water and cold oat milk for an iced drink with a few ice cubes.  * Adjust the amount of syrup for larger drinks (like 12 to 16 ounces).  Notes This chai syrup is moderately spiced, if you like your chai strong, you can use more syrup in your drink, double the spices in the syrup, or replace the water in your drink with brewed chai for a double-strength chai latte.  #chaisyrup #chai#chaisyrupi#chailattes#chaia#starbuckscopycats#starbucksdrinkse#starbucksrecipeairyfreedrinks #dairyfree

Here are Three things I hate about my 21’ Audi RS7.  Full disclosure. I love my car to death. It’s fast, fun and extremely handsome - not unlike myself.  But, also unlike myself, it has flaws.  First up- This thing tries to kill me regularly. Ive tried turning off all of the assists to find out what exactly it is, but the Audi pre-sense tech tends to attempt to assist in keeping you going in your lane and will correct if you veer hard. Unfortunately that means if you’re in a neighborhood with left turn lanes, the car will think you’re going into that lane instead of keeping straight. It’s a niche situation, but one I’m in sometimes.  Second is the soft limiter set to 3000 rpms. The RS highlight is this twin turbo v8. And it sounds fantastic under load! Hell, it might be the best sounding among the 3 germans in this class. However, you can only hear it when you’re breaking the law. That sucks.  Lastly is the turbo lag. Sometimes when the engine is still cold the car will lag when you get on the accelerator from a stand still. It’s not the biggest deal, but it’s almost gotten me into trouble sometimes when im EXPECTING power and im not getting any.  All in all? Still a fantastic car. Love driving it. Owning it has been wonderful.  #Audi #AudiRS7 #Audisport #luxurycar #cars

Saddle fitting this mare has been tricky and here's why: she's 5 which is an awkward stage for them, has uneven shoulders, is hip high and has uneven muscle tone.  Where do I start with what's wrong here.. For starters this saddle is far too forward on Icy's wither. It should be sitting behind the shoulder to open it open for movement. There's way too much rock to the tree - with hip high horses it's a game of give and take to find the right one. The right shoulder (left on video) is bigger, making that bar angle tight on that side. Saddle is sitting to the left because of it. Gullet is a bit too low (too big) and the rigging area looks to be pinching. Did I miss anything? Let me know! Horses can act out due to pain as a result of an improper fitting saddle! Sofrito is a liquid seasoning used for traditional Caribbean dishes. Although different islands use more or less ingredients, the basics are onions, garlic, peppers and cilantro. No matter what you include, sofrito seasoning is super easy to make and never disappoints!  Sofrito ingredients: 1 bunch cilantro 1 bunch cilantro (optional) 4 green onion stems 1 red bell pepper 1 green bell pepper 1 cubanelle pepper (optional) 6 sweet peppers 1 red onion 1 white onion 1 garlic head 1 lime or lemon 1 tablespoon white vinegar 1 tablespoon olive oil Recipe: Rough chop all the vegetables Combine all but the oil in a blender You may have to do a bunch and once blended continue to add if it doesn’t all fit at once Blend for 3-5 minutes, depending on the consistency you’d like If too thick, you may add a few tablespoons of water Once at desire consistency, add olive oil to emulsify by blending one more minute Store in air tight container in the fridge for 2 weeks You may also freeze for up to 6 months Tips: Freezee in ice cube molds and store in ziplock bags for easy use Adding a little more acidity like lime or vinegar can prolong unfrozen sofrito an additional week, but always double check (taste or smell) before use Use whatever I have laying around before it goes bad Some people like to include other seasoning like adobo or oregano, but opt out because I like to see how much I actually put in an individual recipe In some islands, tomatoes are common for this recipe; you may include some like two beefsteak tomatoes Feel free to get creative and use what you normally use to cook, like hot peppers if that is your preference Sofrito is great for seasoning meats like poultry or used in beans and seasoned rice Let me know what you would change or already do differently  Buen Provecho! #sofrito #dominicansofrito #sofritorecipe #vegan #betsaniaathome

Garlic knots 🤝 Pigs-in-a-blanket  Elevate your snack game with this unexpected twist! Introducing Garlic Knot Pigs in a Blanket – a guranteed touchdown for Superbowl celebrations! The combination of store-bought pizza dough, a copious amount of garlic and teeny weenies make these the MVP of any snack table.  1 stick butter, sliced into tablespoons 4 cloves of garlic, finely chopped 1 tablespoon finely minced parsley 1 lb. pizza dough  12 mini hot dogs  3/4 cup finely grated parmesan cheese  Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Melt the butter in a small sauce pot. Once melted, add garlic and parsley. Cook for two minutes or until the garlic is fragrant. Set aside.  Cut the pizza dough into 12 portions. One at a time, roll a portion of the dough on a floured surface to make a 6-inch long stick. Place a hot dog in the middle of the stick and tie it in a knot. Place onto a parchment lined sheet tray. Repeat with the rest of the hot dogs.  Brush the knots with half of the garlic mixture. Place the tray into the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes or until the dough is risen and beginning to brown ontop. While still warm, brush with the remaining garlic mixture and then cover each knot with a tablespoons of cheese. Step 2: Heat the oil in a small saucepan, add the shrimp, season with salt and pepper and cook for about 1 minute on each side, then remove them and set aside.  Step 3: fry the shallot and garlic in same oil until golden, then add the Tom yum paste and cook for one minute. Then add coconut milk and turn the heat to low once it comes to a simmer.  Step 4: Add the udon noodles to the boiling water and cook for one minute, then transfer the noodles directly into the sauce pan along with the shrimp and stir to coat. Let the shrimp finish cooking, and turn off the heat. Step 5: plate and garnish with scallions and nigella seeds. 🚶‍♀️ Unpopular opinion alert: Relying solely on walking as your exercise routine typically isn't enough... especially if you have MS.  While walking is definitely a beneficial part of the puzzle for improving mobility, it's important to incorporate two other components for a well-rounded approach to improving your mobility & movement. 1. Functional Strength Training  Functional strength training exercises helps build muscle in specific muscle groups, improves balance, and enhances overall strength. This can be particularly beneficial for individuals with MS, as it can help counteract muscle weakness and fatigue. 2. Flexibility and Balance Exercises:  Integrating flexibility and balance exercises into your regimen can help improve range of motion, reduce stiffness, and enhance stability.  These exercises can help prevent falls and improve functional mobility in everyday activities. By incorporating these additional components into your exercise routine, you can address a broader range of fitness needs and optimize your overall health and well-being.  Remember, it's essential to consult with a healthcare provider or physical therapist to develop a personalized exercise plan that suits your individual needs and abilities. Marinated Goat Cheese WithCrispy Garlic  • • Ingredients: •1/3c olive oil •4 cloves of garlic •1.5 tbsp parsley •1.5 tbsp chopped chives •1/4c basil, chopped •1 tsp thyme •1/8 tsp salt •Cracked pepper to taste •1/4 - 1/2 tsp Red pepper flakes, to taste •15oz goat cheese •Drizzle honey over every layer Directions: 1. Mince 4 cloves of peeled garlic and set aside. In a medium sized pan, heat 1/3c olive oil on low-medium heat.add in your chopped garlic and stir around. It should be lightly sizzling. The goal here is to get the garlic golden brown. Once your garlic is golden brown, pour olive oil and garlic into a jar or bowl and set in the fridge to cool. 2. Chop your herbs (parsley, chives, and thyme, basil). Add to your olive oil. Add salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes to the olive oil. Set in the fridge to marinate. 3. In the dish you’re serving out of, break up 15oz of goat cheese into chunks. Do your first layer, drizzle with honey. Add some marinade over top. Add another layer of goat cheese chunks, drizzle with honey, and marinade, repeat 1 more time until you have 3 layers. Top with freshly chopped basil. Marinated Tofu Slices (vegan lunch ‘meat’ ) by @TheLatinaHealthCoach 🥪 🌱 Ingredients  1 block extra firm tofu, drained  
 3 tbsp soy sauce
 2 ½ tbsp maple syrup
 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
 1 ½ tsp liquid smoke
 2 tsp dijon mustard
 1 large clove of garlic – minced  Instructions: Using a kitchen towel or tofu press, press the tofu to remove access water. Then using a vegetable peeler, peel the tofu creating thin slices and set it aside. To a small bowl add soy sauce, maple syrup, balsamic vinegar, liquid smoke, Dijon mustard and garlic and whisk to combine. Transfer the tofu slices into a container and pour the marinade over the tofu. Cover and let marinate for 30min or overnight. Once ready, remove the marinated tofu slices from the refrigerator and evenly distribute on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Preheat the oven to 400° F and then bake the tofu slices for 15-20 minutes or longer until all of the marinade is somewhat dry. Remove from the oven and enjoy!  #thelatinahealthcoach #abuelasplantbasedkitchen #TofuRecipe #VeganCooking #HealthyEating #PlantBased #VegetarianRecipe

Bulging disc in lumbar spine  Experiencing pain in your lower back with sharp/shooty/numbness/tingling running down the back of your leg? It might be linked to a herniated or bulging disc in your lumbar spine. When this happens the disc pushes on the nerve roots coming out of the spinal canal which can cause nerve related pain.  Bulging discs can be really irritating. In the acute phase, or in the early stages, we need to work on reducing the pain going down the leg. As the pain reduces going up the back and less in the legs it is considered a good thing and termed “centralization.” Once this happens we can focus on lumbar and core stability training 👊🏼 Here are our 4 favorite exercises for bulging discs:  1️⃣Lumbo-sacral distraction w/ pelvic tilts  2️⃣Repeated press-ups 3️⃣Banded lower trunk rotations  4️⃣Pallof press in split stance w/ foam pad 🚨Curious if these exercises can help you? Give them a try!  However, it’s important to remember that these are general suggestions and may not be the right fit for your unique needs. For a tailored approach to your recovery and training, scheduling with a physical therapist is the best step. My client with MS improved her strength in just *TWO* weeks!! 🤩💪 *yes pleaseeee!* After a few weeks of doing MS-specific physical therapy exercises that targeted her specific weaknesses, Carol noticed that her regular activities weren’t wiping her out the way they used to. 💥 That’s the power of MS-specific exercise! 💥 Is MS different for everyone? YES. Does MS tend to attack certain muscle groups? YES. If you do exercises specific to those muscle groups w/o overcompensating, can you see improved strength, balance, and mobility quickly? YES. ❌Not all PTs are knowledgable about MS❌ But how can you be sure that your Physical Therapist (PT) is providing proper exercises to help your MS?  Here’s how I would approach this: As an MS-specialized physical therapist, these are the questions I would ask your PT before your session (and the answers I would look for) to avoid only doing orthopedic exercises (which tend to not work as well for those with weakness from MS). Ask them these questions: 1️⃣ What is neuroplasticity? Yes, you can retrain your brain to result in more strength... and it’s vital that your PT knows improved strength and mobility is possible with MS!  Exercises that promote neuroplasticity can help improve your function and slow your MS progression. You’ll want to find a PT that not only understands neuroplasticity, but values it as part of their ongoing treatment plan. 2️⃣ How will my exercises differ from an orthopedic injury or weakness? Because MS is not a physical injury, their exercise plan for you should reflect that.  For results that truly change your trajectory, you’ll need to focus on MS symptoms like spasticity, balance issues, and fatigue to prioritize function and mobility. 3️⃣ What is functional exercise? With my MSing Link members and 1-1 clients, we are focused on making everyday movements and activities easier and more enjoyable, despite dealing with MS symptoms.  Functional exercise is just that - exercises focused on your strength, balance, and coordination in real-life scenarios to help maintain independence. 📚Would your PT pass the test?!📚 Physical therapy is costly and time-consuming, so working with a PT unfamiliar with MS won’t hurt you, but it won’t speed up your progress or provide the relief you need.  A knowledgeable PT can make a significant difference in your healing! While asking questions upfront may feel awkward 😬, it can save you precious time and effort.  Never be afraid to ask questions—it’s all part of your journey to better health and mobility. What has been your experience with physical therapy and MS? Let’s talk cubital tunnel.  The cubital tunnel is where your ulnar nerve passes through as it makes its way to your hand. When this area is inflamed/irritated, this can cause numbness/tingling down your arm into your ring and pinky fingers. Continued pressure into the area can cause clawing in your hand and decreased grip strength.  If surgery is necessary, they will likely release the cubital tunnel (similar to what is done with a carpal tunnel release). Sometimes, they will move your ulnar nerve. This is an ulnar nerve transposition.  These are the exercises I typically have my patients start on post op. Typically we shoot for 10 reps 3-5 times/day.  DON’T FORGET TO MOVE YOUR UNINVOLVED JOINTS! Let’s avoid incessant secondary stiffness!  As always, please follow the instructions from your hand therapist and surgeon! When it comes to improving mobility and balance with MS, small daily habits add up in a BIG way! 💥👇 On a recent episode of The MSing Link podcast, I sat down with @thefunctionalfootdoc (aka the amazing Dr. Emily Splichal) to talk about how to improve foot sensation in MS.  Dr. Splichal talked about how consistent daily rituals, like using toe spacers or rolling out your feet, can have a profound effect on our bodies 👣 She also shared that 70% of the nerves in our feet are sensitive to vibration – which is why vibration therapy can be a powerful tool for people with MS! It can help with:  ✅ Waking up nerve pathways ✅ Improving circulation and balance ✅ Maintaining muscle strength ✅ Reducing spasticity and muscle tightness If you’ve never tried it, here’s what to know:  ➡️ Up-and-down vibrations are the most beneficial for stimulating your nerves and muscles compared to side-to-side or rotational vibrations. ➡️ Just 10-15 minutes a day with a vibration platform or roller can make a big difference. Two easy ways to make Korean strawberry cheong—both delicious and make the perfect pairing with your matcha! - 2:1 ratio – More fruit, less sugar (2 cups strawberries, 1 cup sugar) - 1:1 ratio – Balanced sweetness (2 cups strawberries, 2 cups sugar) - Note: 1 carton of 🍓was used here, about 450 g.  Here’s how to make strawberry cheong—  - Slice fresh strawberries 🍓 - In a clean jar, alternate layers of sliced strawberries and sugar. Finish with a layer of sugar on top. This helps to create a barrier that draws out the juices from the strawberries and ensures that the strawberries are well-coated. - Gently press down the layers to help the strawberries release their juices. - Seal and refrigerate for up to 7 days. - After 7 days, strain the mixture to separate the syrup from the strawberries. - Perfect way to elevate your matcha. Enjoy! Storage: Up to 1 month in the refrigerator. Which method would you try? #strawberrycheong #strawberrysyrup #homemadesyrup #strawberrymatchalatte #homecafe #matcha #matchalatte #yujomatcha

Tuna Noodle Casserole 🐟🍝🥘 This meal prep recipe is packed with protein, flavor, and nutrition! I partnered with @Wild Planet Foods to create this warm and cozy dish that is perfect for this cold winter season. I truly love how their tuna is sustainably caught, hand-cut and packed, and has more protein per can than many other brands because they don’t add any broths, water or fillers to their tuna. It’s just pure tuna and a little sea salt. Enjoy!  Servings: 5 Serving Size: 225g  Macros per Serving: 665 cal, 47g P, 65g C, 32g F Estimated Cook Time: 60 min Ingredients: -3 cans of tuna  -1 package of protein pasta -4 cups cold milk  -2 cups panko breadcrumbs  -2 cups white cheddar or mozzarella cheese  -1 cup Parmesan cheese (plus 1/4 cup for the breadcrumbs)  -1 cup diced yellow onion  -1 cup diced mushrooms  -1/2 cup frozen peas  -4 tbs flour  -2 tbs softened butter  -2 tbs melted butter  -1 tbs minced garlic  -1 tsp dried parsley  Instructions: -heat a Dutch oven on medium heat and melt 2 tbs of softened butter  -sauté mushrooms, onions, and garlic until soft  -add breadcrumbs, 1/4 cup Parmesan, 2 tbs melted butter, and parsley into a bowl; mix well -add flour to the pan and continuously mix until it thickens and darkens in color  -pour in milk, scrape the bottom of the pan, and bring the milk to a simmer  -boil pasta to al dente according to package instructions  -add cheeses to the creamy sauce with strained pasta, frozen peas, and canned tuna; mix well -divide equally into meal containers, top with breadcrumbs, and bake at 375F for 20-30min until breadcrumbs are golden brown and crispy -store in the fridge for up to 5 days or in the freezer for up to 6 months #mealprep #mealprepping #healthyfood #recipes #easyrecipes #wildplanet #tuna #tunarecipe #tunacasserole #cleaneating #healthyrecipes #lunch #lunchideas #macros #protein #highprotein #dinnerideas #weeknightdinner #seafood #food #cooking #homechef

The Tonic Labyrinthine Reflex (TLR) is designed to help with extension and flexion against gravity. It helps to develop muscle tone. It helps to integrate the visual and vestibular systems. It makes way for the Landau and the STNR. And so much more 🙌 . If your child struggles with the Superman activity: 👉 Can't lift arms, legs, and head off the ground and hold against gravity  👉 Can't maintain the extension (holding arms and legs straight) with relative ease 👉 Moves around a lot in order to "stay up" Then they might have a retained TLR - meaning the primitive reflex is stuck and might be holding them back from developing higher level movement patterns. . Instructions: * Prepare the sauce. * Divide nori sheets into 4 equal squares. * Mix chicken with all the spices in a bowl. * Preheat the oven to 400°F. * Place 1 tbsp of rice in the center of each nori square. Save this juicy BLT recipe for your next delicious lunch, dinner, or even breakfast. Full recipe below @Chefbriduff  Ingredients * 2 pieces of Seeded Multigrain Bread, toasted * 9 pieces Bacon, 3 softly cooked & 6 crispy * 2 Leaves Iceberg Lettuce * 2 Tomatoes, Heirloom or Roma (or combo) * Aleppo Mayo (recipe below) * ***Aleppo Mayo * 3 Tablespoons Mayonnaise * 1 teaspoon Aleppo Pepper * 1 Clove of Garlic, minced * Pinch Smoked Salt Instructions * Heat a medium sauté pan over medium heat. Once hot, add the bacon to your pan, making sure not to crowd them. Cook the first batch until just done but not quite crispy, and set aside on a paper towel-lined tray. Add the second batch and cook until nice and crispy, then set aside on the tray. * As your bacon cooks, make the Aleppo mayo. Add the Aleppo pepper and a pinch of smoked salt to the mayonnaise and stir to combine. Then, finely mince your garlic with a pinch of salt to help break it down, turning it into a paste, and add it to the mayo. Mix it to combine, then set it aside. The longer it sits, the more the flavors will infuse into it. * Once your bacon is done cooking, keep your pan grease and put the pan over medium heat! Put the two pieces of toasted bread into the pan and let it absorb some of that bacon fat while making it extra crispy for about 20 seconds. * Spread a thin layer of Aleppo mayo onto the non-crisped side of each piece of bread. Put three crispy pieces of bacon on each piece of bread. Add a leaf of iceberg lettuce to the bacon, then layer with sliced tomatoes. Then, do the same on the other piece of bread. Add a pinch of smoked salt and a crack of black pepper on top of the tomatoes. * For the final layer, add the 3 slices of softly cooked bacon and put it on top of one of the sides with tomatoes. Then, stack the other side on top. Behold, the most glorious BLT. #bacon #lunchrecipe #lunch #recipeinspo #chefrecipe #foodnetwork #cooking #cookingathome #blt

Из-за сор и просто игнора влд и многих трудностей. Я передала права другому человеку. После этого началось то что показано на 1 кадре видео. И я закрыла флуд на эмоциях. Teach your kid how to spell with DICTATION! I do this immediately after teaching a new phonics sound or concept.  Have the new sound displayed for them to see and give them a few words to spell using these steps: 1. Pound the word (repeat the word) 2. Tap the sounds 3. Write the sounds 4. Read back the words A lot of kids are so quick to spell words without even thinking about the sounds they hear. This helps them slow down and really think about. It also connects phonemic awareness with spelling and reading. If you’re doing spelling tests each week with a set of words to memorize, REPLACE them with dictation tests! This will teach them the skills they need rather than just memorizing a list of words. Give them random words on the day of the test to find out if they’ve really mastered the phonics skill. The best crockpot shredded beef meal prep 🤤  This meat is also amazing in tacos!!  What you’ll need👇🏽 -1 lb rump roast (ask if they can trim excess fat, this is really the leanest beef that does well in a crockpot)  -beef bone broth  -hatch chili peppers  -spicy or mild taco seasoning  -basmati white rice  -cilantro  -lime  -black beans  -salt,pepper, spray oil for pan  Sear seasoned steak until evenly browned  Mix bone broth, hatch chili peppers, and taco seasoning in crockpot and turn on high  Add steak and cook on high for 6-7 hours  Rinse one cup of white rice and add rice and water ratio to rice cooker and set to cook.  Once rice is done add in chopped cilantro and lime (adding after helps cilantro to not get gross and wilted and rice not to turn soggy) and mix Once meat is done add shredded meat, rice and black beans evenly to meal prep containers. When ready to eat top with avocado or guacamole and enjoy!! Gluten Free Buttermilk Biscuits 😋 Gluten-Free Skillet Biscuits Ingredients: 	•	2 cups gluten-free all-purpose flour (with xanthan gum if not already included) 	•	1 tbsp baking powder 	•	½ tsp baking soda 	•	½ tsp salt 	•	1 tbsp sugar (optional, but nice for balance) 	•	6 tbsp cold butter, diced 	•	¾ cup buttermilk (or ¾ cup milk + 1 tsp vinegar or lemon juice) 	•	1 tbsp plain Greek yogurt or sour cream (optional — adds tenderness) 	•	Extra butter for brushing Instructions: 	1.	Preheat oven to 425°F (218°C). Place a cast iron skillet (10-12 inch) in the oven while it heats up. 	2.	In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and sugar. 	3.	Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until it resembles coarse crumbs. 	4.	Stir in buttermilk and yogurt just until a dough forms. Don’t overmix. 	5.	Turn dough out onto a floured surface (use gluten-free flour) and gently pat it into a 1-inch thick round. Fold it over itself 2–3 times for flakiness, then pat it out again and cut into rounds. 	6.	Carefully remove the hot skillet from the oven. Add a small pat of butter to coat the bottom. 	7.	Arrange biscuits in the skillet so they’re touching slightly — this helps them rise tall and stay moist. 	8.	Bake for 15–18 minutes, or until golden brown on top. Brush with melted butter as soon as they come out. Tips: 	•	Add chopped herbs or shredded cheese for a flavor boost. 	•	For vegan: use vegan butter and plant-based milk + vinegar. #glutenfree #glutenfreerecipes #glutenfreebiscuits

Bacon Wrapped Dates - Dates are a superfood for pregnancy but personally I’m not the biggest fan of them. I find them too sweet and sticky, I typically have a hard time having more than one until I tried Bacon Wrapped Dates stuffed with Goat Cheese. I love sweet and salty food so this is hands down my favorite way to eat Dates that I’ve discovered so far and the best part is its so simple. The saltiness of the bacon balances the sweetness of the dates while complimenting the creamy cheese.  A lot of sources do not recommend eating soft cheese like goat cheese HOWEVER after lots of research, the concern is typically in unpasteurized cheeses which is more common in soft cheeses however if you live in the U.S like I do, you would be hard pressed to find unpasteurized cheese given the laws of very strict regarding this. Benefits of Dates on Pregnancy: 1. Helps in preventing birth defects: Dates are a good source of folate. Folate prevents congenital defects related to the brain and spinal cord. CDC recommends folate supplements and intake of folate-rich foods before and during pregnancy, to prevent congenital disabilities. 2. Vitamin K for the baby: Babies are born with low Vitamin K, which aids in clotting and bone development. If the mother consumes dates during and after pregnancy, the baby may get some amount of this vitamin through breastmilk. 3. Glycemic index: A serving of about four dates has a glycemic index of around 42, which is considered low. This means that dates have a slow-release effect on blood sugar, which can be helpful for women with gestational diabetes or those monitoring their blood sugar levels. 4. Beneficial to Labour: Dates have been studied for their potential to promote and ease late-term labor in pregnant people.Eating these fruits throughout the last few weeks of pregnancy may promote cervical dilation and lower the need for induced. They may also be helpful in reducing labor time. SALSA PESTO  Una salsa deliciosa; fácil y con este truquito les juro que queda como de restaurante. (Blanquear las hojas de albahaca antes de procesar). Ingredientes para preparar salsa pesto en casa: 2 tz de albahaca fresca; use orgánica  1 tz de aceite de olivas o de aguacate 1/4 tz de piñones (usé sin tostar) o utiliza las nueces que tengas en casa. 1/4 tz de lonjas de queso parmesano en bloque Ajo y sal rosada al gusto  Pasa primero las hojas de albahaca por agua hirviendo con sal por aprox 30s; retira e inmediatamente llévalas a un bowl de agua con hielo, para detener la cocción. Seca las hojas con un trapo o Scott y listo; lleva todos los ingredientes a una licuadora o procesador de alimentos; hasta obtener una salsa suave. Prueba y ajusta sabores si es necesario. Yo la dejo un poco rústica para sentir los trozos de nueces y del queso. Y listo a diafrutar; puedes guardar en frasco de vidrio con tapa en la nevera; te dura de 3 a 4 semanas si. Oxidarse y dañarse. Yo la uso para preparar pastas, sándwiches, con los huevos sabe deli; aliñar el pollo; hasta para dippear. En fin; el pesto es una salsa muy rica, alta en grasas saludables y es muy versátil para dippear. Si la haces en casa cuéntame abajo en comentarios cómo te va. 🦅 The Raptor Trust is a family-owned bird sanctuary located in The Great Swamp National Wildlife Refuge.  The proximity to Route 287 also makes this a great stop to stretch your legs, visit the birds, and have a picnic while traveling through the area. 💴 Admission is free, but there are donation boxes at the entrance.  Be sure to bring cash to support this very worthwhile organization. ♿️ Accessibility: It is a network of wide, flat, packed gravel walkways.  We have a jogging stroller with inflatable wheels, but I would think most wheelchairs and strollers could be used here with no issues.   🎒 What to Bring: Cash (see above re: donations), Bug Spray (it’s in a swamp and can get buggy), Water Bottle 🐕 What to Leave Home: Pets and any toys that light up or make noise.  This is a rehabilitation center.  There are reminders throughout the sanctuary to keep noise to a minimum.  We reminded our kids before entering (and several times throughout) to use inside voices even though we were outside, and to not make sudden, extreme movements. 🍽️ Bring your own, there are no concessions here.  There are some benches near the parking lot if you want to picnic there or head down the road to the Somerset County Environmental Education Center.  They have several picnic tables, some of which are in the shade. 🚻 There are restrooms located on-site, but they are to the left of the parking area, so I suggest going before or after your walk through the sanctuary. Kuan Miao Noodles with Vegetables and Shrimp 🍜🍤🌶️🥕🧄🧅🥬 Recipe 👇🏽👇🏽👇🏽 This dish is loved by everyone, both adults and children, and can be enjoyed both hot and cold. You can use different vegetables and any meat such as beef or pork, chicken – it all depends on your preferences. We’ll prepare it with shrimp. Ingredients: * 250g Kuan Miao Noodles * 250g shrimp * 40g sweet pepper (I used red) * 2 carrots (I used yellow/orange) * 50g any mushrooms (I used brown mushrooms) * 1 onion * 70g napa cabbage * 2-3 cloves of garlic * 2-3 green onions * 3 tbsp teriyaki sauce (sauce from the previous video) * 30ml vegetable oil * 30ml fragrant sesame oil * Salt/pepper to taste Instructions: * Bring water to a boil, add the noodles. Once it boils, add about 100ml of cold water. Continue boiling, repeating this process several times. Cook for 4-5 minutes after the first boil, preventing the noodles from overcooking. After cooking, immediately transfer the noodles to cold water, thoroughly rinse to remove excess flour, and stop the cooking process. Drain through a sieve. Your noodles are ready! * Cut all vegetables as you like. Finely chop garlic. Clean and wash the shrimp, pat them dry with a paper towel. * Heat a pan over medium heat, add vegetable and sesame oil, then garlic and shrimp. Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add chopped vegetables and stir for about 5-7 minutes until they are slightly sautéed. * Add the noodles, pour teriyaki sauce, mix everything, and cook for another 3-4 minutes until the liquid evaporates, allowing the dish to dry slightly. Add salt and pepper to taste. * Enjoy your meal! 😊 💡I served it with egg noodles (whisked eggs, fried in vegetable oil, rolled into a roll, sliced into strips). Ingredients •300g spaghetti •1 or 2 zucchini  •4 tbsp extra virgin olive oil •1 garlic clove (optional) •Salt&pepper to taste •Pecorino Romano or Ricotta salata Directions: 1.Clean and cut the zucchini into slices, more or less thick depending on your taste. 2.Add extra virgin olive oil and garlic to a pan and heat. Add the zucchini slices and cook them for a few minutes on each side. They should be golden brown. 3.Cook the spaghetti in plenty of salted water. 4.When you have fried all the zucchini, set them in a bowl and add the cooked spaghetti to the pan with the cooking oil. 5.Add freshly ground pepper and mix well. Donuts “Buñelos Månglo’ (Air Donuts)” If you’re looking for a very simple yet satisfying treat this Valentine’s Day, these doughnuts are it! Pack this delicious, sweet and easy to make dessert - and share them with a loved one this month! Comment down below if you have ever experienced a typhoon. ⛈  These fried treats are also referred to as “typhoon donuts.” Growing up on an island, came with frequent tropical storms - which for the most part were fun in terms of having opportunity to bond with loved ones. However, the power outages, cleanups + other major threats to life obviously were not. Typically triangle/diamond-shaped, these donuts were often prepared as it required just basic and minimal ingredients. It’s also referred to as “air donuts.” Call it as you wish, but just know it’s tasty fried dough complimented by a pinch of sugar. Simply delicious, you have to try this!  📝 Full Recipe  Prep time: 15 minutes Cook: 3 minutes Yield: 24 donuts, more or less  Ingredients  •2 cups all-purpose flour •1/2 cup granulated sugar •1 tablespoon baking powder  •1 cup coconut milk •1 tablespoon vanilla extract •oil, for frying  •sugar, for garnish - optional Directions •Add flour, sugar and baking powder in a large mixing bowl. Stir to combine. •Slowly add in the coconut milk, while mixing.  •Add the vanilla extract and mix dough.  •Knead dough until smooth. •Now, heat oil in a large frying pan or pot - oil should be no more than half way full. While oil is heating, start preparing the shaped donuts. •Gently roll the dough out on a lightly floured work surface by hand or rolling pin. •Then cut into heart or traditional triangle/diamond-shaped pieces. Do this by using a heart cookie cutter and/or a pizza cutter. Dough should be about 1/3 inch thick or so. •Turn heat to medium-high and fry dough in hot oil until golden brown - about 2 to 3 minutes, turning at least once. •Once cooked, remove donut and place on a cooling rack or paper towel to drain excess oil.  •Enjoy as is, or add hot donuts to a flat surface or plate and dust with sugar.  Helpful tips •If dough is too moist or sticky, add more flour until you get a smooth consistency. If it’s too dry, add more milk.  •You can cut donuts into your desired shape. I did hearts in honor of Valentine’s Day. Traditionally it’s cut into triangles or diamonds, but today many shape them in various ways. All preference. •I used grape seed oil for frying, but most oils like vegetable or canola may work.  •Dusted sugar is optional. Feel free to add cinnamon or omit garnishing.  💞follow and connect with me on my other socials for more “island-mex” inspired recipes. links in bio. 🤔Shoulder mobility and thoracic mobility are crucial components of functional movement, assessed in the Functional Movement Screen (FMS). These aspects play pivotal roles in various daily activities, sports, and exercises, making them essential for overall physical performance and injury prevention. Firstly, optimal shoulder mobility allows for a wide range of motion necessary for activities such as reaching, lifting, pushing, and pulling. Limited shoulder mobility can lead to compensatory movements, increasing the risk of injury in both the shoulder joint and surrounding musculature. Secondly, thoracic mobility, the ability to move the upper back and rib cage, is vital for maintaining proper posture and spinal alignment. Poor thoracic mobility can result in compensations in adjacent areas such as the neck, lower back, and shoulders, potentially leading to discomfort, pain, and decreased performance. Furthermore, adequate thoracic mobility is crucial for efficient breathing mechanics, facilitating optimal oxygen intake during physical exertion. Restricted thoracic mobility can hinder proper expansion of the rib cage, limiting lung capacity and compromising cardiovascular endurance. #Mobility #ShoulderMobility #ChiropractorCare #SportsHealth #PhysicalTherapy #AthleticTraining #MassageTherapy #DrKyleRoss #DrKaitHoff #DrAdamAltman #HealthcareProfessionals #WorkplaceWellness #InjuryPrevention #FitnessForProfessionals #ErgonomicHealth #sportschiropractic #chicagochiropractor
